test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: In an equilateral triangle ABC, P is the centroid of this triangle. Side of ΔABC is 16√3 cm. What is the distance of point P from side BC?
solution:
Given:

Side of triangle = 16√3 cm

Centroid = P

Concept used:

Height of equilateral triangle = √3/2 × a (where a is the side of the triangle)

Centroid divides median in the ratio of 2 : 1.

Calculations:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/66058a8e7cc0d836c4b5cc50f24160fe3a4ada6af96e83f6677fcddd77912ef4.png] 

⇒ Height = AD = √3/2 × a 

⇒ Height = √3/2 × 16√3

⇒ AD = 24 cm

⇒ AP : PD = 2 : 1

Let, AP = 2x

PD = x, AD = 3x

⇒ 3x = 24

⇒ x = 8

∴ The value of PD is 8 cm.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
